Here is the complete file:line-cited inventory of real CPU computation in G-mOMonadOS, ordered roughly by weight/centrality. All paths absolute.

---

# TIER 1 — CPU kernel interpreters (duplicate the GPU twelve-mark semantics)

These are the direct CPU copies of the GPU kernel stepping rules — the highest-priority port targets.

**1. Self-contained twelve-mark VM: `Kernel` in `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/kernel.rs`**
- `struct Kernel` at kernel.rs:121; `impl Kernel` at kernel.rs:161.
- `Kernel::tick()` kernel.rs:280 — the core single-step dispatch over all twelve/sixteen marks (VINIT, TANCH, AFWD, AREV, CLINK, EVALT, FSPLIT, FFUSE, EVALF, ENGAGR, IFIX…). Includes balanced-paren FFUSE matching scans at kernel.rs:235 and kernel.rs:257.
- `Kernel::run(max_ticks)` kernel.rs:487 (`while !halted` loop), `run_continuous` kernel.rs:496, `tick_on_timer` kernel.rs:505.
- ENGAGR period walk (walks forward mod n a full period, nested loop) kernel.rs:715–733; further nested mark scans kernel.rs:852. Compute: tight per-tick dispatch loop; heaviest when driven by the census/inception routines below. Self-contained (uses `imasm_core` only for glyph tables).

**2. `cpu_run` — the CPU reference executor in `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/gpu_kernel.rs`**
- `fn cpu_run(ids, max_ticks)` gpu_kernel.rs:988 — instantiates a `Kernel`, runs a program of mark-ids, reads back halted/ticks/depth/regs/engagr/mem/stack. This is the exact CPU twin of the GPU kernel.
- Driven in bulk by `verify` / `verify_mode` gpu_kernel.rs:1033/1052 (random program cross-check loop over `count` programs, length 4..24, comparing CPU vs GPU: loop at gpu_kernel.rs:1101).
- IMASM-nested tick counter gpu_kernel.rs:1143–1163 (`for g in 0..n { cpu_run(...) }` accumulating ticks).
- `banked_reference` gpu_kernel.rs:1009 — CPU expected-value oracle delegating to `imasm_core::lattice_flow::banked_walk` and `imasm_core::imasm16_3::{parse_glyph_word, run_word_register}`. Depends on **imasm_core** (../MoDoT).
- Note: the inception/search census routines around gpu_kernel.rs:383–560 and 1234–1311 enumerate twelve-to-the-d mark-words — these are GPU-side, but their semantics mirror `cpu_run`.

**3. `imasm_core::imasm16_3::Machine` — SIXTEEN_3 register interpreter (dependency ../MoDoT)**
- `struct Machine` `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/../MoDoT/imasm_core/src/imasm16_3.rs:339`; `Machine::step` imasm16_3.rs:361.
- `run_word_register(steps)` imasm16_3.rs:426, `run_trace` imasm16_3.rs:507, `run` imasm16_3.rs:527. Plus `lattice_flow::banked_walk`. This is a separate CPU interpreter of the same mark algebra. Lives in **imasm_core**, imported widely (see dependency list below).

**4. `vox::verdict` — the SIXTEEN_3 CPU auditor (dependency ../Vox / vox_core)**
- `pub fn verdict(word: &[char]) -> char` `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/../Vox/src/vox.rs:393` — computes the tri-ancestral T/N/B/F control-flow verdict via `cyclic_pairs` + `cyclic_interior` (edge-pairing of ∈/∋ over the cyclic word, work-opcode interior scan). Supporting: `open_forks` vox.rs:431, `cyclic_pairs`/`cyclic_interior` above vox.rs:380. Compute: light per-word but called in bulk over disassembled binaries. **vox_core**.

**5. `vox::imasm_vm::Machine` — full x86 interpreter (dependency ../Vox)**
- `struct Machine` `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/../Vox/src/imasm_vm.rs:70`; `impl Machine` imasm_vm.rs:112.
- Parser imasm_vm.rs:130; `load`/`store` imasm_vm.rs:208/213; effective-address `ea` imasm_vm.rs:220; condition codes `cc` imasm_vm.rs:254; `do_syscall` imasm_vm.rs:330; `alu` imasm_vm.rs:416 (with a `for _ in 0..count` rep-loop at imasm_vm.rs:456). This is a real instruction-level x86 CPU emulator (the "raw/elf" auditor). Heavy when running actual binaries. **vox_core** (reached via `src/vox.rs`, `src/vox_decode.rs`, `src/gpu_vox.rs`, `src/tower_vox.rs`).

---

# TIER 2 — Factoring / number theory on CPU (arbitrary-precision, the compute core)

**6. `factor_membrane` — big-integer Hensel-lift factoring: `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/factor_membrane.rs`**
- Main balanced-split factor driver factor_membrane.rs:158–189 — nested loops over `p_bits`/`q_bits` from bits(N)/2 downward, each calling `hensel_unbraid` (low arm, bit-by-bit carry-propagated Hensel lift) and `range_prune_unbraid` (high arm, top-down interval prune). BigUint/BigInt arithmetic via `native_numeral` word ops (`multiply_via_word`, `divmod_via_word`, `subtract_via_word`), verified with `syzygy_preserves`.
- `prime_indecomposable` → `is_prime_miller_rabin` factor_membrane.rs:196. REPL entry `repl_factor_membrane` factor_membrane.rs:286 (test loop over "91","143","8051" at :424). Compute: exponential-worst-case branch search with big-int multiply/divide at every node — very heavy. Self-contained (uses native_numeral).

**7. `winding_period` — order-finding factoring (u64): `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/winding_period.rs`**
- `winding_order(a, N)` winding_period.rs:102 — baby-step/giant-step multiplicative order: builds m≈√N baby table (loop :108), sorts/dedups, giant-step walk (loop :116) with `powmod`/`mulmod`/`modinv`. O(√N) memory+time.
- `minimal_winding` winding_period.rs:131 — strips prime factors from the period (trial-division loop :141, fixpoint loop :150).
- `factor(N, tries, seed)` winding_period.rs:233 — Shor-style classical: random base, gcd, order, gcd(a^(r/2)±1,N) (loop :234).
- `closure_gcd` :169 and `closure_gcd_big` (BigUint) :187 — p^e product over primes ≤ B then gcd (loops :172/:191). `is_prime_mr` Miller-Rabin :284. `gen_prime`/`repl_factorgen` :314. `pow_mod`/`gcd`/`isqrt` helpers :55/:64/:92. Self-contained.

**8. `native_numeral` — arbitrary-precision word arithmetic: `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/native_numeral.rs` (3428 lines)**
- The bignum engine behind the factoring membranes. `encode`/`decode` numeral words :59/:102. Schoolbook multiply (`multiply_via_word` region) native_numeral.rs:353 (`for i in ...` limb×limb). Knuth Algorithm D long division native_numeral.rs:462–540 (`divmod`, normalization :494, quotient-estimate loop :501, `qhat*v0` correction :512, multiply-subtract inner loops :522/:540). Bit ops: `bits_halve`/`bits_double`/`bits_subtract` and their word wrappers `halve_even_by_word` :564, `double_via_word` :600, `subtract_via_word` :630. This is the tightest big-integer numeric loop code in the repo. Uses **imasm_core** glyph tables; arithmetic self-contained.

**9. `prime_winding` — grounded arbitrary-precision arithmetic + Brent rho: `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/prime_winding.rs`**
- `big_gcd`, `factor_bounded` (Brent's rho + trial division, word-native) reached via `grounded_factor_report` prime_winding.rs:276 (comment ":269 division + Brent's rho"). `grounded_gcd/add/mul/sub/mod/divmod_report` :200–265. Miller-Rabin arbitrary precision via `BigUint::modpow` :391 (13 witnesses). Digit-type tensor/address :125/:142. Self-contained. Consumed by trilattice_factor.

**10. `trilattice_factor` — winding + rho + congruence-of-squares sieve: `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/G-mOMonadOS/src/trilattice_factor.rs`**
- `winding(n, a)` trilattice_factor.rs:341 — arbitrary-precision order-from-winding then gcd(a^(r/2)±1,n), halving loop :386; falls through to rho search. Leaper walk loop :168. `sieve` (congruence of squares over factor base) advertised at :228. Uses `prime_winding::{digit_encode, factor_bounded, big_gcd}` and native_numeral word ops. Self-contained.

**11. Vox factoring stack (dependency ../Vox) — sub-exponential arms**
- `../Vox/src/sieve.rs`: quadratic sieve `qs` sieve.rs:332, Dixon `dixon` sieve.rs:147 (relation collection loop :161), GF(2) linear-algebra null-space over the relation matrix sieve.rs:174–293 (nested bit-matrix elimination), Tonelli-Shanks `sqrt mod p` :60–94, Legendre :28. Tape-based bignum. **vox_core**.
- `../Vox/src/morphism_factor.rs`: numeral factoring through `mod_mul` with Miller-Rabin/ECM/p-1/p+1/rho (comment morphism_factor.rs:145); bit-limb loops :174. **vox_core**.
- `../Vox/src/factor_operator.rs`: `resolve_moat` factor_operator.rs:56 (DFS stack of lo-word states, loop :63), `full_resolve` :107 (trial-division loops :113/:120/:123, worklist :131), `repl_factor_operator` :185. **vox_core**. (Also mirrored self-contained at `src/factor_operator.rs`, 668 lines.)
